questions.q: In a certain code language, ‘RAJ’ is coded as ‘87’ and ‘GITA’ is coded as ‘148’. How will ‘VARUN’ be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is :

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number.

RAJ → Total number of letter is 3.

R(18) + A(1) + J(10) = 18 + 1 + 10 = 29

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

29 × 3 = 87

And,

GITA → Total number of letter is 4.

G(7) + I(9) + T(20) + A(1) = 7 + 9 + 20 + 1 = 37

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

37 × 4 = 148

Similarly,

VARUN → Total number of letter is 5.

V(22) + A(1) + R(18) + U(21) + N(14) = 22 + 1 + 18 + 21 + 14 = 76

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

76 × 5 = 380

Hence, VARUN will be written as “380”.

questions.q: The monthly income of three cricketers Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan, from different sources, are in the ratio of 12 : 9 : 7, and their expenditures are in the ratio 15 : 9 : 8. If Ankit saves 25% of his income for future investments, what is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan?
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Income ratio of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively: 12x : 9x : 7x

Expenditures ratio of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively:

15y : 9y : 8y

FORMULA:

Savings = Income - Expenditures

CALCULATION:

Saving ratio of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively:

(12x - 15y) : (9x - 9y) : (7x - 8y)

[Saving ratio = Income ratio - Ependiture ratio]

Ankit saves 25% of his income, So saving of Ankit is

12x - 15y = 25% of 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = 41​ × 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = 3x

⇒ 9x = 15y

⇒ yx​ = 915​

⇒ yx​ = 35​ (divided by 3)

So, x = 5; y = 3

Put the value of x and y saving of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan,

(12x -15y) : (9x - 9y) : (7x - 8y)

⇒ (12 × 5 - 15 × 3) : (9 × 5 – 9 × 3) : (7 × 5 - 8 × 3)

⇒ (60 - 45) : (45 - 27) : (35 - 24)

⇒ 15 : 18 : 11

Hence, ‘15 : 18 : 11’ is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan.

questions.q: C. Rajagopalachari led the Salt Satyagraha in which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Tamil Nadu.

Key Points

• C Rajagopalachari led the Salt Satyagraha protest in Tamil Nadu.

• Inspired by the Dandi March by Mahatma Gandhi, a group of 100 men led by C Rajagopalachari marched to Vedaranyam and extracted salt from seawater in April 1930 to break the salt law imposed by the British.

• He began his march from Tiruchi on April 13 and reached Vedaranyam on April 28.

• The Salt Satyagraha was an act of civil disobedience led by Mahatma Gandhi to protest British rule in India.

Additional Information

• Salt March or Dandi March or Salt Satyagraha, was started by Mahatma Gandhi in the year 1930 in the March-April period.

• It was the protest of the Indian people against Britain’s Salt Act of 1882 which prohibited Indians from collecting or selling salt, a staple in their diet.

• Gandhi declared resistance to British salt policies to be the unifying theme for his new campaign of “satyagraha,” or mass civil disobedience.

• First, Gandhi sent a letter on March 2, 1930, to inform the Viceroy Lord Irwin that he and the others would begin breaking the Salt Laws in 10 days. Then, on March 12, 1930, Gandhi set out from his ashram, or religious retreat, at Sabarmati near Ahmedabad with several dozen followers on a trek of some 240 miles to the coastal town of Dandi on the Arabian Sea.

• In April, Gandhiji was joined with the tens of thousands of followers for their salt satyagraha.

Time taken by 8 persons to complete to leftover work

time taken to complete the whole work = 5 + 21 + 1 = 27 days

questions.q:
Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

options: The professor informed the media persons that from our research we have come to the conclusion that there had been life on that planet.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is The professor told the media persons that from their research they had come to the conclusion that there was life on that planet.

Key Points

• The given sentence is a direct speech.

• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​

• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added.

• The first-person pronoun ''our'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''their'', the first-person pronoun ''we'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''they''.

• The present perfect tense format 'Subject + have + V3 (come) + Object' will be changed into the past perfect tense format 'Subject + had + V3 (come) + Object'.

• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (is) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-

Indirect Speech
